review_scope: Compared all 23 candidate frames with the matched main frames, then inspected the fuse panel and roof landing candidate frames at full size. The standalone rooftop dialogue review establishes the new planter instance in context. This is a technical comparison of visible installed surfaces and framing.

images.observation: The floorboard grain and table edges remain readable. The spotlight and colored floor mark are visible in the same positions.
The tile grout remains visible across the beam and curtain edge. The companion face carries a different frame of text.
The resident, slatted blind, radiator and floor finish remain legible. The existing near white highlight at right is present in both views.
The lamp, window slats and furniture feet align. Floorboard texture continues through the light and across the dark foreground.
The warm beam still resolves the worn plaster through the kitchen aisle. Both counter silhouettes and wall fittings are present.
Gauge, brass valves, left pipe and floor contact remain visible. The surrounding service room stays dim in both frames.
Shelves, chair and closed door frame are intact. The shelf finish and plank pattern carry between the two views.
The grout rows and vertical metal strip remain separated. The cistern and wall joint retain visible edges against both finishes.
The brick and horizontal mortar are discernible in both dark views. Fine equipment detail is limited by the established exposure.
The open cabinet, switchgear, fuse seats, wall conduit and plaster pitting remain discernible. The candidate shows a modest shadow and brightness difference around the enclosure.
Both captures retain the brass edge, floor tile and bench profile. The dark under-counter composition limits fine detail of the animal.
The cat silhouette and pale forepaws separate from the green wall. Framed print and ledge remain visible in the same framing.
The red ceiling member, striped wall and frames remain distinguishable. This inherited view is dark and offers limited close detail of the cat.
The brass mailbox faces and labels register against the wood paneling. The bench and notice remain visible under the same dim exposure.
The radiator fins, towel and repeated blind slats remain readable. The floor and wall edges show no visible discontinuity next to the radiator.
The threshold, rails, cage and drive gear retain their silhouette and separation. Minor light variation leaves the roof landing and door hardware readable.
The seams and metal bands still read on the water tank. The skyline and parapet material remain legible under both cloud frames.
The instrument face, metal rim and board remain distinct. A small highlight difference leaves the underlying finish recognizable.
The tiled wall, corner and plumbing read through the close view. The flush tank still separates cleanly from the surrounding tile.
The flowing residue retains color and its outline against the floor and radiator. The high-contrast companion and lamplight stay in frame.
The upright organic strands still read separately from radiator grilles, print and wall finish under the spotlight.
Toaster, utensils, table grain and crumb field remain recognizable in the same counter composition.
The plate and fittings are visible against the mottled surface. The familiar dark outer frame still limits fine hardware detail.
